description: Canonical display order for the language menu, shared by all three drivers and the site so the list can never desync. Latin-script native names first (UTF-8 byte order), non-Latin scripts last — so accented/special-character names like Čeština sit after Türkçe, exactly as the menus render them. Every locale JSON shipped in data/locales/ MUST appear here. The site and the Linux driver read this order at runtime; the macOS and Windows tables are pinned to it. All four are enforced by tools/test/test-locale-order-single-source.cjs.
